readerCopy.body: An escape can start looking irresistible when the need underneath it has gone unnamed for too long. When Neptune squares Lilith, a crush, fantasy, online fixation, secret plan, or wish to disappear may carry more emotional weight than the situation itself can support. The desire is not automatically false just because the story around it has become inflated. Strip away the person, image, or imagined future and ask what you are actually missing now. If the answer is attention, freedom, sex, rest, creativity, privacy, or change, deal with that need before giving the fantasy control of the decision.
